key_points: Meta's AI agent Muse hit No. 1 on US iPhone free-app charts within two weeks of launch, outpacing ChatGPT's early adoption curve and signaling strong consumer traction.
Multiple sell-side upgrades and price-target hikes (KeyBanc to $900, BofA, Mizuho, Cantor Fitzgerald) with estimates 3-4% above consensus through 2028.
Wall Street is repricing Meta as Muse is seen as a new revenue engine, with partnerships (e.g., Shopify) beginning to convert user adoption into monetization.
Stock already surged 11.4% in a single session, reflecting rapid repositioning by institutional and retail investors.
The Muse launch is reshaping competitive dynamics across AI agents, chipmakers, brokers, and storage — reinforcing Meta's AI leadership narrative for the next several quarters.
